content.text: The clause matches the preferred position exactly.

input.quote: 28.1 This Agreement and each dispute arising from it are governed by the laws of the State of New York, without regard to conflict-of-law principles.
input.rationale: Section 28 selects New York law (§28.1) and gives the state and federal courts in New York County exclusive jurisdiction, with mutual submission to personal jurisdiction and a carve-out for interim injunctive relief (§28.2). That is exactly our preferred position: an accepted governing law with court venue rather than arbitration. A document-wide search returns no arbitration provision, so there is no foreign-seated arbitration concern. The pre-filing executive escalation in §28.3 is mutual, capped at fifteen business days, and expressly does not delay urgent relief or limitations-period filings, so it does not impair our access to the courts. No redline needed.
